alternatives.nom: Stowarzyszenie Architektów Polskich (SARP) — association créative, section UIA

rows.notes: IARP (registration chamber, compulsory in order to sign) ≠ SARP (voluntary association, UIA section). 14,300 active members in September 2025 (archistaty.pl, from IARP data; +58% since 2010). The generic title “architekt” is not protected; what is protected are the autonomous technical functions. Searchable public list, with no total and no export. ACE 2024: 13,700 — concurs.

alternatives.nom: Obec architektů (section UIA, site redirigé vers Grand Prix Architektů)

rows.notes: 4,288 authorised architects as at 1 January 2026 (3,071 men / 1,217 women) + 207 emeritus members; the title “autorizovaný architekt” is protected (Act 360/1992). Pitfalls: the UIA section is Obec architektů, not the ČKA; buildings are also signed by ČKAIT authorised engineers. Public database (~290 pages) with no export.

alternatives.nom: Archinfo.sk — portail et annuaire des architectes slovaques

rows.notes: Chamber created by Act 138/1992 (architects + landscape architects); authorisation compulsory, protected title. No aggregate count found (the zoznamy are JS-driven, with no total) — ACE 2024 estimates 1,900. The UIA section is Spolok architektov Slovenska (SAS, an association); sasarch.sk unreachable (TLS) when tested.

Membership compulsory for design practice rights; it is the activity that is reserved, not the title. 11,499 members (2023) — includes ALL MÉK specialisms (design, interior, landscape, urban planning), not only design architects (ACE 2024 estimates 7,000 architects). The MEKON névjegyzék is searchable, with no total and no export; scope widened since October 2024 (site managers) — inflated series to come.

alternatives.nom: OAR București — Tabloul teritorial consultable en ligne

rows.notes: Act 184/2001: title and signature right reserved, Tabloul Național al Arhitecților (TNA) managed by the OAR; ~2,700 members at its founding (2001), current total not published in open access — oar.archi blocks robots (403). The COMPLETE TNA is published every year in the Monitorul Oficial (2024 edition: M.Of. 485 bis of 27.05.2024) → potential grade A; legislatie.just.ro also filters robots. The OAR (UIA section) ≠ UAR (the legacy association). ACE 2024: 6,200. HARVEST 5 August 2026: the BUCHAREST branch extracted in full from its site (updated 25 June 2026) — 4,752 registrants, of whom 4,495 arhitecți (3,022 with signature right, 718 stagiari, trainees), 240 conductori (conductor arhitect, a distinct Romanian qualification grade with no English equivalent), 17 arhitecți de interior; the Ș/Ț pages were missed by the crawl at first and then recovered (+122). Nr. TNA observed up to 13,784 = ceiling of historical national registrations. The national register remains geo-blocked.

alternatives.nom: Съюз на архитектите в България (САБ) — association, section UIA

rows.notes: ЗКАИИП Act: design capacity (ППП/ОПП) is obtained compulsorily through the КАБ; “more than 4,500” architects, landscape architects and urban planners (official site, recorded from extracts — kab.bg serves a JS challenge to robots). The complete register is promulgated every year in the Държавен вестник (e.g. ДВ бр. 34 of 11.04.2023) → massive nominal list in PDF. UIA section = САБ (association), not the КАБ. ACE 2024: 4,000. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the Регистър 2026 in ДВ брой 10 of 27.01.2026, grade B→A): 3,571 architects with FULL ППП capacity (3,269 BG + 9 EU + 6 third-country + 287 under art. 230 ЗУТ) — the former “4,500+” conflated architects, landscape architects (318) and urban planners (27, in the corpus annexes) across all capacities; WARNING: volumes II-III (ОПП, restricted capacity) are in ANOTHER ДВ material, not yet harvested — 3,571 is an exact floor (a lower bound), not the КАБ total.

alternatives.nom: Udruženje hrvatskih arhitekata (UHA) — fédération de 11 sociétés régionales

rows.notes: Public imenik with a displayed total: 2,998 active (4,078 including retired/dormant), recorded 2026. The title “ovlašteni arhitekt” is protected (2015 Act). Pitfalls: separate register for urban planners (do not add them together without de-duplicating); Croatia does NOT appear on the list of UIA sections checked in August 2026 (the UHA was nevertheless a member of it — to be re-verified). ACE 2024: 2,900 — concurs.

rows.organisme: Zbornica za arhitekturo in prostor Slovenije
rows.notes: 1,111 members of the architects' section (the title “pooblaščeni arhitekt” is protected, ZAID Act) out of 1,806 ZAPS registrants (1,335 active, 471 inactive — official statistics page, undated). Pitfall: the imenik requires a login (verified) — no public search; the chamber also covers landscape architects and spatial planners: do not take the ZAPS total for the number of architects. ACE 2024: 1,600.

rows.organisme: State professional certification (Атестаційна архітектурно-будівельна комісія) — ЄДЕССБ register

alternatives.nom: Національна спілка архітекторів України (НСАУ) — union créative, section UIA

rows.notes: Qualification certificate compulsory in order to practise independently (official Дія guide verified); the title in itself is not protected. Public search of certified persons on e-construction.gov.ua (verified), no total displayed — headcount null (ACE 2024 estimates 3,700). Pitfalls: the old НСАУ “реєстр” page is dead; data.gov.ua datasets are likely but unverified; updates disrupted by the war.

rows.organisme: Союз архитекторов России (voluntary union — no compulsory professional order)

alternatives.nom: НОПРИЗ — Национальный реестр специалистов (projeteurs responsables, ingénieurs inclus)

rows.notes: No compulsory professional order and no protected title: individual licensing disappeared in 2007. Actual access to the profession runs through the company SROs and the Национальный реестр специалистов (НОПРИЗ) for design project leads — portal verified, no headcount displayed, and it includes engineers. The САР (voluntary union, UIA section — still listed) publishes a public database: “Общее количество членов союза: 11 180” (2026 counter).

rows.organisme: TMMOB Mimarlar Odası (Chamber of Architects, within the Union of Chambers of Turkish Engineers and Architects)
rows.notes: 98,872 members as at 31 December 2025 (46,443 women / 52,429 men) — official TMMOB table verified; 80,789 at the end of 2023. Membership compulsory for private practice and for signing (Acts 6235 and 3458), but public-sector employees are exempt. No public nominal register: verification through the şubes (branches). Pitfall: interior architects have their own chamber — do not add them together.

rows.organisme: Ministry of Industry and Construction — State attestation of experts; licences to design companies
rows.notes: Quick pass: no professional order — licences to COMPANIES, individual attestation for experts. Searching data.egov.kz brought nothing up; register to be looked for on the e-license/gov.kz side. Union of Architects = UIA section confirmed.

rows.organisme: Ministry of Construction — licences to design organisations
rows.notes: Quick pass: no compulsory individual registration — licences to organisations. No public count. Union of Architects = UIA section confirmed.

rows.organisme: Ministry of Construction, Architecture and Housing (formerly Gosstroy)
rows.notes: Quick pass: gosstroy.gov.kg redirects to minstroy.gov.kg (verified). Activity licences managed by the State; no public register and no count. Not among the UIA sections; the national union reportedly survives through the МАСА (unverified).

rows.organisme: Committee for Architecture and Construction under the Government
rows.notes: Quick pass: the committee's site (tajsohtmon.tj) no longer resolves — no deliverable URL. Licences to organisations; no public register. Not among the UIA sections.
Quick pass: near-total opacity — no public register, no headcount, no verifiable URL. Not among the UIA sections; the existence of an active union is uncertain.
